model: 2D rigid cross-section DEM with fiber bonds and unilateral compression contact
support_model: left pin and right roller on horizontal plates; end rotations free; vertical restraints assume both supports stay in contact

plastic_collapse.criterion: first displacement-controlled reaction at or above the plastic limit load
plastic_collapse.mechanism: one central plastic hinge between existing simple supports

post_failure.model: instantaneous severance of both interfaces adjacent to the punch block

assumptions: rectangular section with uniform tensile and compressive strength blocks
simply supported beam with a central plastic hinge
post-limit central separation is imposed instantaneously; no fragment dynamics are simulated
post-limit stress vectors are hidden because the dynamic release path is not modeled
